latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of bridge-pattern-implementor: enables decoupling of abstraction and implementation using the Bridge Pattern.

- Helps users identify and apply the Bridge pattern to prevent class explosion when abstraction and implementation axes vary independently.
- Provides step-by-step guidance for analyzing codebases or design scenarios, including when to use Bridge versus Adapter or Strategy.
- Introduces the evaluate-extremes process for defining the Implementor interface (balancing intersection vs. union of functionality).
- Supports integration with Abstract Factory for runtime selection of implementations.
- Designed for any coding environment, with or without an existing codebase.
